compliance_rules.content: OFAC Sanctions: Transactions with entities on the SDN list are prohibited. Financial institutions must screen all parties against the SDN list before processing transactions.
Anti-Money Laundering: Transactions exceeding $10,000 require CTR filing. Suspicious activity must be reported via SAR within 30 days of detection.
Know Your Customer: Financial institutions must verify customer identity using government-issued ID, proof of address, and beneficial ownership information for entities.
SWIFT MT103: Single customer credit transfer message format. Field 50K contains ordering customer, Field 59 contains beneficiary, Field 32A contains value date and amount.
